title: David Plays Music for Saul
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler whose gift is comfort, and tonight David uses his harp to calm a troubled king: Willow sings Mom’s bath-time song to her crying baby brother until he is clapping along.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because she knows a soft song can help a hurting heart. In Willow’s world today: her baby brother bumps his head on the table and cries and cries. Willow sits down beside him and sings the little bath-time song Mom always sings, slow and soft. His crying gets smaller and smaller, and soon he is clapping along. Just like David playing his harp for King Saul, Willow learned that our gifts are for helping someone else.
